title: Caching Repeated Work: Prefix and Prompt Caches
summary: The cheapest token is the one you never compute. This lesson covers reusing the KV cache for shared prompt prefixes, the arithmetic of provider prompt-caching discounts and break-even hit rates, and designing prompts so their shared prefix gets reused.
objectives: Explain prefix (KV) caching and compute the prefill time and cost it saves for a shared prompt prefix
Compute the expected cost per request under a provider's cached-read discount and cache-write premium, and the break-even hit rate
Structure prompts so the stable part comes first and estimate hit rate from request rate and cache lifetime
prerequisites: You should know prefill and the KV cache ([Context Windows, Prefill and the KV Cache](/learn/model-foundations/context-and-kv-cache)), and PagedAttention blocks ([Batching and Scheduling](/learn/inference-and-serving/batching)).
